### Adoption Risk
```{r adoption_risk , echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE}





library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

my_colors <- c("0. Will Lose" = "black", "1. High Risk" = "red", "2. Moderate Risk" = "orange","3. Low Risk"= "green")

data=op_list$renewals %>%
  select("mean_consumption","days_until_renewal","Account Name","Amount","Account Risk","Close Date")

data$dAmount=dollar(data$Amount)                                         

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = `days_until_renewal`, y = `mean_consumption`, 
                      text = paste("Account:", `Account Name`,
                                   "\n Close Date: ",`Close Date`,
                                   "\n Amount: ",`dAmount`,
                                   "\n Consumption: " ,`mean_consumption`))) +
  geom_point(aes(size= Amount, alpha=.3,color=`Account Risk`)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adoption Risk",
    x = "Days until renewalr",
    y = "License Consumption"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Convert the ggplot object to a plotly interactive plot
interactive_plot <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

# Display the interactive plot
interactive_plot
  
```


### Onboarding Risk
```{r onboarding_risk , echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE}





library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

my_colors <- c("0. Will Lose" = "black", "1. High Risk" = "red", "2. Moderate Risk" = "orange","3. Low Risk"= "green")

data=op_list$renewals %>%
  select("Adoption Phase","Vitally Days as Customer","Account Name","Amount","Account Risk")

data$`Adoption Index`=as.numeric(factor(data$`Adoption Phase`,levels=c("-" ,"Planning","Installed",
                                       "Configured","MVP Complete","Use Case Pipelining",
                                       "90% Adoption"))  )    
data$dAmount=dollar(data$Amount)                                         
data= data %>%
  filter(`Adoption Phase` %in% c("-" ,"Planning","Installed","Configured","MVP Complete"))
# Create the ggplot2 scatter plot
# Map 'car' and 'cyl' to aesthetics to include them in the hover-over
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = `Vitally Days as Customer`, y = `Adoption Index`, 
                      text = paste("Account:", `Account Name`,
                                   "\n Adoption Phase: ",`Adoption Phase`,
                                   "\n Amount: ",`dAmount`))) +
  geom_point(aes(size= Amount, alpha=.3,color=`Account Risk`)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    labels=c("unlabelled", "planning", "Installed","configured","MVP Complete")) +
  labs(
    title = "Onboarding Risk",
    x = "Days as Immuta Customer",
    y = "Onboarding Phase"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Convert the ggplot object to a plotly interactive plot
interactive_plot <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

# Display the interactive plot
interactive_plot
  
```
